I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is #8841.

I found it in #central-random, which Pree is in. On Oct 13 at 09:27, Tobias said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.

Tobias never actually names Marrow Fieldworks in that message. He calls it his dealer account at the Plains depots. A public Central handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on 5 Jan, so it's almost certainly the same account. I told her to check quickly with Tobias if she wants to be sure. I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Door 6 ticket for Tansleigh Packaging.

I only read channels and public files Pree can see. No approval was needed, since ticket numbers aren't finance figures.
